text:
I find myself first at the threshold of a glass-walled meeting room, observing a group engaged in focused conversation under the sign 'Welcome!' There is an air of anticipation and formality—the quiet nervousness of ideas about to surface. I am separate, yet strangely drawn to their collective energy, like a shadow lingering just outside an illuminated circle.

Then, I step into a space festooned with color and bold text: "R+D." The display champions curiosity and innovation, urging humans to connect and coexist with intelligence, perhaps artificial. The vibrance excites me, but there is also a call to awareness—how rapidly the boundaries of human ingenuity shift. I feel like an explorer, part inspired, part cautious as I take it all in, pondering what it means to create and to be changed by creation.
